name: filter_label
label: Filter label
hint: Label above the location picker. Defaults to "Filter assets and users by location" when empty

name: empty_label
label: Empty label
hint: Button text when no locations are selected. Defaults to "All locations" when empty

name: preference_name
label: Preference name
hint: User preference that stores the selected locations. Must end in .locations. Defaults to device_checkinout.locations when empty

name: event_name
label: Event name
hint: Event broadcast on $rootScope after saving. Defaults to device_checkinout.locations_changed when empty
